entries.en: to feign artfully (mañosamente); to practise fraud, to cheat
entries.notes: M 栏另记变体读法 chõ pè（l. 行），不影响判义；西语 mañosamente 与汉字[作弊]互证。

entries.zh: 冒名姓；冒用他人名姓、假托名义
entries.en: to feign another's name; to impersonate, pass oneself off under a false name

entries.zh: 矫揉造作；伪装出良好外表、假装正经
entries.en: to feign a fair outward appearance; to be affected, artificial
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:揉/操]两读存疑，两读同音且皆合矫饰义，依「矫揉造作」判为伪装良好外表。

entries.zh: 虚文；虚饰门面、空有形式（徒有其表）
entries.en: empty formality; mere outward show, seeming without being

entries.zh: 倚仗、自恃（倚凭所学而佯装有学问）
entries.en: to presume upon one's learning; to make a show of knowing
entries.notes: 西语词头句式疑有脱讹（y tener saber 与佯装义不密合），汉字「倚藉」义为倚仗，对应略隔；M 栏仅录一音节声调，降为中置信。

entries.zh: 妖言；忸怩作态的娇饰之言
entries.en: bewitching, deceitful words; speech feigned with affectations and airs

entries.zh: 借名姓；冒用（他人/我的）名义行事，犹如某人亲自所说所为
entries.en: to act under a borrowed name; "use my name" — as if it were so
entries.notes: 缩写 đtos. 未展开（疑为 dichos），R 栏为讹读西语残句 como si…，判义主要依汉字「借名姓」与 M 栏补注（借我名姓）。

entries.zh: 借名姓；冒称他人名姓、自称是谁
entries.en: to take a name, claiming to be that person; pass oneself off under another's name
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:藉/食]两读存疑，两读皆可通冒用名姓义。

entries.zh: 假古；装假作态（佯装圣贤般道貌岸然）
entries.en: to feign, put on false airs; to act like a pretended saint

entries.zh: 吓骗；佯装动怒以吓唬哄骗
entries.en: to feign anger so as to frighten and deceive; to dupe
entries.notes: 西语 pengañar 为非标准形，视作 engañar 之别体；义由汉字「嚇騙」坐实。

entries.zh: 昧心；虚伪不实、昧着良心作假
entries.en: feigned, false; against one's conscience, insincere

entries.zh: 瞒心；存心欺瞒、心口不一
entries.en: deceitful of heart; feigned and false
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:瞞/膨]两读存疑，均含欺瞒义，从「瞞心」。

entries.zh: 号；名号、署押所用之名（亦可指商号字号）
entries.en: signature mark, name; also a trade name or shop mark

entries.zh: 画号；署名画押、以笔画号
entries.en: to sign; to draw one's name-mark
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:畫/疊]两读存疑；R 栏西语 firmar: 佐证签署义。

entries.zh: 誊名；代誊名姓以为署押
entries.en: to sign by transcribing the name (on another's behalf)
entries.notes: 西语尾词 intorrextura 疑为讹读、义不明，判义依汉字「謄名」。
汉字[疑:僉/簽]两读存疑，均为签名义。

entries.zh: 签押；官员（官老爷）签押画字
entries.en: to sign and affix one's mark; the Mandarin's (official's) signature
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:僉/簽]两读存疑，均为签押义；西语点明 Mandarin（官员）所用。

entries.zh: 写供状；罪囚与原告签署判词供状（画押）
entries.en: to write/sign the deposition; the accused and the accuser sign the sentence
entries.notes: 西语尾词 confindiendo 疑为 confirmando/confesando 之讹，不影响判义；汉字「寫供狀」与闽南语音写互证清晰。

entries.zh: 画招；涉讼人画押具招（官署核准后签署招认）
entries.en: to sign one's confession; the litigants sign, the court consenting
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:招/抬]两读存疑，从「畫招」（画押招认）；西语 La casa 疑指官署。
